description: Narrows template_category to the seven motion graphics templates that actually exist and adds "comparison" (previously unreachable). The other four values ("data", "roller", "cinematic", "reveal") were never implemented with a matching template_data shape, so every scene that picked one rendered a placeholder. MINOR bump per RFC 0007: only widens what the field means going forward, on the same string type; a historical artifact using a removed value is a past render, never re-validated.

search_terms.description: Concrete photographable subjects for AI image generation.

template_category.description: If set, this scene uses a motion graphics template instead of (or overlaid on) the AI image. Each value maps to exactly one hand-built composition — see engine/prompts/visual_planner for the template_data shape each one expects.

template_data.description: JSON-encoded props for the template. Examples: {"events":[{"year":"1947","title":"Independence"}],"title":"Timeline"} for timeline, {"items":[{"name":"China","value":"1.4B"}],"title":"Top"} for ranking, {"value":"4,300 km","label":"LENGTH"} for counter, {"leftLabel":"BEFORE","leftValue":"$100","rightLabel":"AFTER","rightValue":"$10,000"} for comparison.
